name: Fame H(a)unter!
source:
Embrace yourself as a shameless fame-seeker, find a common language with your new, absolutely adorable dolly, and... Try your best not to die in the process.

[From [url=https://jesterorchestra.itch.io/fame-haunter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
把自己当作一个无耻的追名逐利者，与你的新的、绝对可爱的洋娃娃找到共同语言，然后……尽力不要在这个过程中死去。

[来自[url=https://jesterorchestra.itch.io/fame-haunter]Itch.io[/url]]
